At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

For energy & renewables teams, these are the three workflows we would look at first:

Energy & renewables: where a pilot could start
  01: Connection intake
  02: Supplier handover
  03: Invoice reconciliation

Our energy & renewables page puts it like this: “Track connection applications, supplier handovers and maintenance paperwork. Engineers can see which records are available and which still need review.” For each workflow it sets out the request, the work, who keeps authority and the evidence that closes the case. There is also a calculator for putting a value on the time at your own case volumes.
